thesis: The site is the load ticket: every claim carries a counted number, and scrolling turns the tally.

signature.name: Load Ticket
signature.summary: Torn manila strip with SVG hand-tally marks and a running total drawn from the active tool output; closes every section as a physical receipt of the arithmetic just shown.

motion.intro: Tally strokes draw beside the hero photo and the 35 sq ft per bale number counts up in 1.1 s.
stories: Bale counter pinned on desktop while the bed outline draws segment by segment and the bale stack grows one bale per 35 sq ft.
Load ticket strip wipes in at each section end driven by --sw-p.
motion.hover: Buttons lift 2 px; ticket strip accent brightens on hover.
